trends.name: Iran Ceasefire & Oil Price Collapse
trends.summary: U.S.-Iran agree to 2-week ceasefire, triggering sharp oil price drop below $94/barrel (largest decline since 2020). However, real-time X posts reveal Iran has already launched missiles at UAE, Qatar, Kuwait since ceasefire began, signaling fragility. Trump administration positioned U.S. military in Strait of Hormuz for "supply loading" and oversight, raising questions about truce durability.

trends.name: Trump Trade War & Tariff Threats
trends.summary: Trump threatens 50% tariffs on countries supplying military weapons to Iran while administration expected to slash Iran war funding. Real-time reports reveal millions of Americans already paid billions in tariffs later ruled illegal with no reimbursement. U.S.-China trade deteriorating despite soybean export props; Ray Dalio signals Trump-Xi meeting will focus on trade and capital flows.

trends.name: Energy Sector Production Hits & Oil Majors
trends.summary: Exxon reveals 6% production hit to Q1 vs Q4 from Middle East conflict, split between Qatar and UAE operations. Shell also reports production impact. Maersk halts value protect service for reefer cargo in Middle East. Energy stocks face margin pressure despite lower oil prices creating mixed signals for sector performance.

trends.name: Delta Airlines Beats Earnings, Cuts Growth
trends.summary: Delta reports Q1 adj. EPS of 64¢ (beat 57¢ est.) with $423M net profit and raises Q2 guidance to $1.00-$1.50 EPS. However, airline announces it will "meaningfully" cut growth plans, expecting $300M boost from its refinery offset by reduced capacity additions. Stock surged on earnings despite revealing structural headwinds.

trends.name: AI Chip Bottleneck & Taiwan Dependency
trends.summary: Even best U.S.-made AI chips require round-trip to Taiwan for final processing, exposing geopolitical supply chain vulnerability. Broadcom riding Anthropic boom while Nebius gaining as AI GPU shortage persists. This structural dependency on Taiwan threatens U.S. AI leadership and creates vulnerability to cross-strait tensions.

trends.name: Mortgage Demand Plunges On War Uncertainty
trends.summary: Homebuyer mortgage demand drops annually for first time in over a year as Middle East tensions fuel uncertainty. Real estate and housing sectors showing demand destruction from geopolitical risk and rates environment, signaling potential spillover into residential construction and consumer spending.

trends.name: Treasury Yields Fall Post-Ceasefire
trends.summary: U.S. Treasury yields fall sharply following Iran war ceasefire announcement as flight-to-safety demand eases and inflation concerns temporarily recede. Yet inflation pressures from prior conflict remain structural, creating tension between yield compression and longer-term inflation expectations for fixed income markets.

trends.name: Corporate Buybacks Creating Price Floors
trends.summary: Moody's analysis reveals large corporate buyback programs are creating artificial price floors in equity markets, supporting valuations despite fundamental concerns. This mechanical support masks deteriorating earnings quality and creates risk of sharp reversals if buyback pace slows or market sentiment shifts.

trends.name: Nuclear Energy Demand Surge (Cameco)
trends.summary: Cameco positioned as expensive must-have due to AI-driven power demand explosion and potential data center buildout. Nuclear becoming critical infrastructure as energy demand outpaces renewables capacity; sector gaining investor attention despite elevated valuations.

trends.name: Retail Options Traders Panic Buying Puts
trends.summary: For only 3rd week ever, smallest options traders spent 1/3 of volume buying put options to open—matching only COVID washout levels. This extreme hedging signal indicates retail panic and suggests market lows may be forming, though fragility remains given geopolitical backdrop.

trends.name: Healthcare M&A & Drug Pricing Pressure
trends.summary: Gilead Sciences doubling down on acquisitions while drug pricing faces political heat (MarketWatch investigation on medicine costs). Novo Nordisk's Wegovy lower-dose option undercuts Zepbound pricing. GRAIL's NHS trial results disappoint. Healthcare consolidation accelerating as pricing pressure mounts from regulators and competitors.

trends.name: Infrastructure & Industrial Demand Mixed Signals
trends.summary: Caterpillar supported by AI-driven power demand and strong backlog, but Applied Industrial growth not enticing. Infrastructure spending benefiting some equipment makers while others face demand slowdown. Geopolitical uncertainty and tariff threats creating uneven conditions across industrial sector.
